verdicts.reason: A actually rearranges the layout for the square: the headline is set large over four lines and fills the canvas, so the hierarchy is strong. But the bottom row is awkward. The subcopy is a centred, ragged three-line block whose left edge (~95px) doesn't line up with the headline (~125px), and the CTA sticks out past the headline's right edge (~698px vs ~645px), so the row looks improvised. B is just the landscape layout dropped into the square at the same scale. The text block sits high, with a ~185px top gap against ~275px of dead orange below, so it feels lopsided and unfinished, and the headline is small for the format.
